futures.note: No new 2027 prices on Thanksgiving; DraftKings still had the Cubs at +2500 after Rogers and Sato (CBS Sports, Nov. 24). Wednesday made the price worse: three of the Cubs' second-starter options signed elsewhere. Itoh doesn't move it; a real No. 2 would.
